# Min | Founder Profile

Min is Min Sihu, founder of ActaRoot and OHWUT.

## Min

Official page: https://min.tienda/

The founder behind ActaRoot and OHWUT.

### Min Sihu

Min is a short name used by Min Sihu, also known as Sihu Min and 민시후.

He is a 13-year-old founder based in South Korea. His primary personal website is msihu.com.

### ActaRoot

Min Sihu founded ActaRoot, Inc., the U.S. corporation behind OHWUT.

The company publishes its official information at actaroot.com.

- ActaRoot: https://actaroot.com/

### OHWUT

Min Sihu founded OHWUT and identifies himself as its founder and CEO.

OHWUT is an online shopping platform that connects ordinary purchasing with participation-linked price reductions.

- OHWUT: https://ohwut.com/

### The same founder

Min and Min Sihu refer to the same person. This domain offers a concise identity page under the shorter name Min.

For a fuller personal profile, founder background and project descriptions, visit msihu.com.

- Min Sihu full profile: https://msihu.com/
- Min Sihu projects: https://msihu.com/projects/
